subject: [PATCH 8/8] selftests/mm: check that unauthorized MADV_PAGEOUT skips large file folios

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Responded to Sashiko's concern that the test should verify that the underlying folio was not split by the partial-range madvise, but believes it is a false-positive.

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch series adds selftests to verify that unauthorized MADV_PAGEOUT operations skip large file folios when only a partial range is advised. The tests check that the pages of a PMD-sized shmem folio remain resident, both when mapped with PTEs and when mapped with PMDs.
